name: Git xdiff
title: Summarize Git history with exact patches
job: Seven equally weighted units run normal Git command-line work over distinct original repositories. Three units run `git diff-tree --stdin` over 32,768 commits from Git, Cargo, Django and Prettier: full Myers patches for 16,384 commits, and Myers shortstats and histogram patches for 8,192 other commits each. Three more produce complete patches for distinct commits of other repositories with `--ignore-all-space`, the patience algorithm and `-U32767` context. The seventh runs `git merge-file -p` on base, ours and theirs blobs from real merge commits.
objective: Reduce elapsed time of exact patch, shortstat and merge-file outputs over distinct real repository inputs without changing any output or behavior.
operation: Three disjoint commit-batch units: primary full Myers patches (16384 commits), secondary Myers shortstat (8192), secondary histogram patches (8192). Per repository counts 4096/2048/2048, four normal git diff-tree --stdin processes per unit. Four further one-unit xdiff families over other repositories: diff-tree --stdin patches with --ignore-all-space, the patience algorithm and -U32767 context, and git merge-file -p on real merge blob triples (one process per triple).
inputs: 32768 globally distinct commits from Git, Cargo, Django and Prettier, equal 25% by commit count; generic fetch-only git-history payloads pinned by original commit/tree/object and native checkout identities. Further units: 5 public and 6 held-out fetch-only original histories, no repository shared between splits.
outputs: Complete exit status and stdout for every repository batch, compared byte-exactly; CLI stderr preserves error headlines/classes, not runtime stack frames or addresses. Full patch bytes are never reduced or truncated by the adapter.
preparation: Pinned original source archive/compiler/Rust images; canonical source Git root; full input histories fetched and authenticated before timing; runtime network off.
configuration: Distinct batches frozen before new timing. Normal Git dispatch, libc and Rust enabled. Myers primary/default, histogram secondary. No runtime tuning or repeat multiplier. safe.directory accommodates protected read-only input ownership only.
contract: Preserve xdiff public declarations, structs, callbacks, exact patch/stat output and upstream test identities/outcomes. No test/fixture/snapshot changes, precomputed outputs or new process-global state.
limits: Four-project authored public sample, not independent per-commit statistics or a frequency-weighted developer population. Repository replacements preserve the language/count mix and allow larger distinct batches. Each unit runs for at least 1 s.
